text_block_list.text:
At our strategy meeting for the coming
year,
Каррен Тян shows me several
Umamusume social
media stars.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The superhero UmaToker, Бико Пегасус.
The food
Umastagrammer, Hishi
Akebono.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The daily vlog UmaTuber, Тайки Шаттл.
And the
class representative, Sakura
Bakushin O.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All of them are sprinters. Каррен Тян
needs to
compete with all of them next
year, and comes up
with a plan to make
it happen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
